<div class="bodyTxt">
<p id="p2" data-pid="2" class="p2 sb">We come from hundreds of ethnic and language backgrounds, yet we are united by common goals. Above all, we want to honor <a class='pub-ijwbq' data-page-id="mid502012489" href='/en/bible-teachings/questions/gods-name/'>Jehovah</a>, the God of the Bible and the Creator of all things. We do our best to imitate <a class='pub-ijwbq' data-page-id="mid502019180" href='/en/bible-teachings/questions/jesus-son-of-god/'>Jesus Christ</a> and are proud to be called <a class='pub-ijwfq' data-page-id="mid502012470" href='/en/jehovahs-witnesses/faq/are-jehovahs-witnesses-christians/'>Christians</a>. Each of us regularly spends time helping people learn about the Bible and <a class='pub-ijwbq' data-page-id="mid502012120" href='/en/bible-teachings/questions/what-is-gods-kingdom/'>God’s Kingdom</a>. Because we witness, or talk, about Jehovah God and his Kingdom, we are known as <a class='pub-ijwfq' data-page-id="mid502012468" href='/en/jehovahs-witnesses/faq/name-jehovahs-witnesses/'>Jehovah’s Witnesses</a>.</p>
<p id="p3" data-pid="3" class="p3 sb">Explore our site. <a class='pub-ijw' data-page-id="mid1011208" href='/en/library/bible/'>Read the Bible online.</a> Learn more about us and <a class='pub-ijw' data-page-id="mid1011233" href='/en/jehovahs-witnesses/faq/'>our beliefs</a>.</p>
</div>
